meta.what: Round-5 refresh for roadmap items 8 (actual Jan-Aug 2026 goods trade with Russia/Ukraine where the map used estimates or Jan-Jun extrapolations), 22 (latest Kiel Ukraine Support Tracker release, 2025 and 2026 allocations by type) and 27 (pledged vs allocated vs delivered aid).
meta.units: EUR bn, nominal. 2026 = January-August 2026, not annualised. USD converted with ECB monthly USD/EUR reference rates (Jan-Aug 2026 mean 1.1629) for Comtrade monthly data; national Jan-Aug totals at the Jan-Aug 2026 mean.
meta.method: Trade: each economy's own monthly customs report in UN Comtrade (public preview API, HS TOTAL, C00, all modes), summed Jan-Aug 2026; where only Jan-Jul is published, August = median of three seasonal extrapolations from the same series in 2025 (ratios capped at 2); a missing interior month = neighbour average. Kept only where at least 7 months of 2026 are published. National statistics for Kazakhstan (Jan-Aug), Uzbekistan (Jan-Aug turnover), Armenia (Jan-Jun turnover + Comtrade May/Aug), Belarus (Jan-Jul turnover from the Russian side). Values are on the same level as trade_full.json 2025 (Comtrade monthly 2025 sums agree with trade_full 2025 within 1% for all reporters except Israel, which is spliced and flagged). Aid: Kiel Release 31 sheets 'Allocations per Month', '... Military', '... Humanitar' (financial = total - military - humanitarian, because Kiel's 'Allocations per Month Financial' sheet stops at June 2026), plus item-level main data for guarantees, ERA loans and earmark years.
meta.trade_entries_format: countries.<ISO3>.<flow>.'2026' in trade_full.json's format (low/central/high, basis, src, period) plus certainty, previous (the trade_full value replaced) and months_actual.

kiel_definitions.commitment: Declaration of future support by a donor government (framework agreements, MoUs, security agreements, donor-conference pledges). Official stance, not necessarily a legal obligation. Dataset Documentation v1.1 p.6.
kiel_definitions.allocation: Aid 'designated for a more specific purpose' that has 'already been delivered or [is] specified for delivery': technical agreements, procurement contracts, project plans; can be a subset of earlier commitments. Kiel's primary metric. Dataset Documentation p.6; workbook ReadMe; Fig. 5 note.
kiel_definitions.delivery_disbursement: Reported only where donors publish it (heavy-weapon deliveries; budget-support disbursements from Ukraine's Ministry of Finance in Fig. 9). Item-level tot_value_deliv_EUR is 0 for nearly all 2025-2026 rows. Dataset Documentation p.20.
kiel_definitions.loans_and_guarantees: Loans at face value when allocated; guarantees to IFIs that back loans to Ukraine are counted at the guaranteed amount (the IFI loan itself is not tracked). Documentation p.12.
